## Validation fixes

- SwiftPM-only plans no longer require a CocoaPods exception. Plans mentioning CocoaPods,
  Podfile, or podspec still require current approval bound to the work item.
- Formatting can preserve verified upstream licenses and notices without changing their bytes.
  Add exact paths, SHA256 digests, and upstream HTTPS URLs to
  `config/policies/format-preserved-notices.json`. Invalid records, missing notices, and changed
  bytes block validation. Ordinary text files retain whitespace checks.

See [Preserve Upstream Notices](https://github.com/copper-labs/project-governance/blob/2.6.5/docs/guides/preserve-upstream-notices.md)
for setup and file-selection limits. The runtime checks recorded hashes locally; operators still
verify upstream provenance.

This is a backward-compatible patch. Existing installations need no configuration changes.
